verdict.rationale: Kling documents its own RESTful API with JWT authentication using AccessKey/SecretKey, plus global and China endpoints, so it can be driven non-interactively by scripts or CI jobs. The site also advertises an MCP/CLI offering for agent-driven generation at scale and batch automation of the production process. Missing for 10: detailed CLI documentation (only a marketing headline), any CI-specific guidance or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
